segments.name: air transportation and related services
segments.description: Develops, tests and manufactures its eVTOL aircraft and supporting systems while providing air transportation services, including air charter brokerage, to passengers and partners.
segments.evidence: The Company has one operating and reportable segment, air transportation and related services ("Services").

revenueModel.text: Passengers and partners pay for facilitated passenger transportation by helicopter or fixed wing aircraft, customer-directed flights and related air transportation services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Services revenue primarily includes consideration received for (i) facilitation of passenger transportation via helicopter or fixed wing aircraft primarily in the Northeast United States and Southern Europe
